verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a Linux distribution like Omarchy, but the evidence never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Mandatory disk encryption, the default firewall, and the reported bloat-removal option are adjacent privacy and security features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
